name: EpiCurveBench
description: A benchmark that measures the accuracy and robustness of methods that digitize epidemic curves from images into time-series data, with standardized data and evaluation metrics.
evaluation_method: mean absolute error (MAE) / root mean squared error (RMSE) and time-series similarity measures (e.g., DTW)
reputation: A useful, domain-specific benchmark for public-health researchers and tool developers focused on digitizing epidemic curves; modest adoption outside the niche.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; dataset size and image quality vary across examples; labels can contain noise from manual digitization; potential domain shift across plot styles and sources.
